blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation. To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we present AURA 2.0, a streaming video large language model that introduces three core upgrades to AURA. The key advance is Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC), which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context and incorporate returned information into the ongoing interaction. Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs. The model can identify objects marked by users on video frames and produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions. To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA's existing streaming interaction abilities. We further incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams. Evaluations on public streaming benchmarks show that AURA 2.0 achieves leading performance among open-source streaming models, while targeted evaluations further validate its new interaction capabilities. We open-source the model weights and inference code.
blocks.zh: 大多数AI助手只有在被催促时才会回应,即使在视频流中的事件为对话提供了有意义的机会时仍保持沉默. 为了超越纯粹用户驱动的互动,我们推出AURA 2.0,一个流传的视频大语言模型,引入了AURA的三个核心升级. 关键的进展是Model-Intirated Conversation(MIC),它使模型能够确定在不断发展的视觉流中值得讨论的议题,并在适当时刻启动对话,无需用户查询. Stream-Aware Tool Calling(SATC)使该模型能够利用目前的视觉和对话背景来引用外部工具,并将返回的信息纳入正在进行的互动。 互动视觉定位(IVG)支持在用户输入和模型输出中进行视觉定位. 该模型可以识别视频帧上用户标注的对象,并生成帧对齐的边框,将其响应与特定对象和区域链接起来. 为了发展这些能力,我们构建了一个专门的流线互动数据集,并采用一个三阶段的培训计划,将新行为与AURA现有的流线互动能力结合起来. 我们进一步将长视互动记忆(LHIM)纳入其中,以在扩展的视频流上保持背景连续性. 对公共流程基准的评价表明,AURA 2.0在开源流程模式中取得了领先业绩,而目标评价则进一步验证其新的互动能力。 我们打开模型重和推论代码的源头。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Streaming Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) extend video understanding from offline analysis to online interaction over video streams. Unlike offline models that analyze complete videos, streaming VideoLLMs process incoming frames incrementally and generate responses using only the information available so far ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026a ; Yao et al., 2026a ) . Their designs coordinate continuous visual perception with response decisions, enabling models to remain silent during observation and respond when relevant evidence becomes available ( Qian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Context management and memory mechanisms further maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams without retaining all previous frames ( Lu et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026a ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Despite these advances, interaction remains largely user-driven. Responses are triggered by user queries, with models responding either immediately or later when relevant evidence becomes available. However, events in the video stream may offer meaningful opportunities for conversation even without a user query.
blocks.zh:
流取视频大语言模型(VideoLLMs)将视频理解从离线分析扩展到视频流的在线互动. 与分析完整视频的离线模型不同的是,流出VideoLLMs以递增方式处理接入的帧,并仅利用迄今掌握的信息生成回复(Chen等,2024;Lu等,2026a; 姚等, 2026a. (简体中文). 他们的设计将连续的视觉感知与反应决定相协调,使模型在观察期间保持缄默,并在相关证据出现时作出反应(Qian等,2025;Wang等,2025c;Zheng等,2026;Yang等,2026.). 上下文管理和内存机制在扩展的视频流上进一步保持上下文的连续性,而不保留所有以前的帧(Lu等人,2026a; 杨等,2026;姚等,2026a;曾等,2026.
尽管取得了这些进展,互动在很大程度上仍然是用户驱动的。 用户查询引发了答复,模型在获得相关证据后立即或稍后作出答复。 然而,视频流中的事件即使没有用户查询也可能为对话提供有意义的机会.

blocks.en: To move beyond purely user-driven interaction, we introduce Model-Initiated Conversation (MIC) , which enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. In addition to deciding when to respond to a user query, the model must decide whether to initiate a conversation and what to discuss. These decisions depend on both the evolving visual stream and the conversational context: a visual event may offer a meaningful opportunity for conversation, but discussing it may be unnecessary if the topic has already been addressed. The model must therefore use this context to avoid repetitive or unnecessary interruptions.
blocks.zh: 为了超越纯粹由用户驱动的互动,我们引入了Model-Introduction Conversation(MIC),这使得该模型能够识别在不断发展的视觉流中值得讨论的议题,并在适当时刻启动对话而无需用户查询. 除了决定何时回答用户的询问,模型还必须决定是否启动对话以及讨论什么. 这些决定既取决于不断发展的视觉流,也取决于对话的背景:视觉事件可能为对话提供有意义的机会,但如果专题已经得到处理,讨论就可能没有必要。 因此,模型必须利用这种上下文来避免重复或不必要的中断。

blocks.en: Building on AURA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , we present AURA 2.0 , a streaming VideoLLM that introduces MIC as the key advance, alongside Stream-Aware Tool Calling (SATC) and Interactive Visual Grounding (IVG) , while retaining Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA. SATC enables the model to answer questions beyond its own knowledge by invoking external tools using the current visual and conversational context. Returned information is then incorporated into the ongoing interaction. IVG supports visual grounding in both user inputs and model outputs, allowing users and the model to specify which objects and regions they refer to. Users can mark objects on video frames for the model to identify, and the model can produce frame-aligned bounding boxes to link its responses to specific objects and regions.
blocks.zh: 在AURA(Lu et al., 2026a.)的基础上,我们介绍AURA 2.0,这是一个流动的VideoLLM,它将MIC作为关键推进,与Stream-Aware工具Call(SATC)和交互式视觉地面(IVG)一起,同时保留实时QA,主动QA和多响应QA. SATC通过使用当前视觉和对话背景的外部工具,使模型能够解答超出自身知识范围的问题. 然后将返回的信息纳入正在进行的互动。 IVG支持在用户输入和模型输出中都进行可视化定位,使用户和模型可以指定它们所指的对象和地区. 用户可以在视频帧上标出对象,供模型识别,而模型可以生成帧相接的边框来将其响应与特定对象和区域相接.

blocks.en: To develop these capabilities, we construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset and adopt a three-stage training scheme to integrate the new behaviors with AURA’s existing streaming interaction abilities. Building on AURA’s streaming interaction dataset, we introduce new data covering MIC, SATC, and IVG. The resulting dataset comprises approximately 11.4 billion tokens, spanning 5,400 hours of video and 40 million training frames. We employ multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based sample-level verification to ensure data quality and align queries, responses, tool calls, and bounding boxes to video chunks along a consistent timeline. During training, we apply focal-loss-based supervision to the response-control tokens to mitigate their imbalance and support appropriate response decisions.
blocks.zh: 为了发展这些能力,我们构建了一个专门的流线交互数据集,并采用一个分三个阶段的培训计划,将新行为与AURA现有的流线交互能力相融合. 我们利用AURA的流式相互作用数据集,引入了涵盖MIC、SATC和IVG的新数据。 所产生的数据集包括大约114亿个信使,长达5 400小时的视频和4 000万个培训框架。 我们采用基于多模式的大型语言模型(MLLM)样本级核查,以确保数据质量,并按一致的时间表将查询、答复、工具呼叫和框与视频块相接。 在培训期间,我们对反应控制标志实行基于损失的焦点监督,以缓解其不平衡,并支持适当的反应决定。

blocks.en: Further, we incorporate Long-Horizon Interaction Memory (LHIM) and optimize the streaming inference framework to support ongoing interaction over extended video streams. As visual observations move beyond the active visual window, salient events are summarized into textual descriptions and incorporated into the ongoing conversational context. LHIM complements the existing visual context management mechanism of AURA by preserving information about events beyond the active visual window, enabling the model to refer to previously observed events when answering user queries or identifying topics worth discussing.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们纳入了长视互动记忆(LHIM)并优化了流推论框架,以支持在扩展视频流上的持续互动。 随着视觉观察超越了活性视觉窗口,突出事件被归纳为文字描述并被融入到正在进行的对话背景中. LHIM通过保存活动视觉窗口外的事件信息来补充AURA现有的视觉上下文管理机制,使模型在回答用户询问或识别值得讨论的议题时能够参考先前观察到的事件.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , AURA 2.0 demonstrates strong performance on public streaming benchmarks, including PhoStream ( Lu et al., 2026b ) , ProactiveVideoQA ( Wang et al., 2025d ) , IPIBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and StreamArena ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . We further evaluate conversation initiation and response quality for MIC, tool-assisted question answering for SATC, and localization and abstention for IVG. We open-source the model weights and inference code to support reproducible research and practical applications.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,AURA 2.0显示在公共流线基准方面表现良好,包括PhoStream(Lu等,2026b.),《主动VideoQA》 (Wang等,2025d.),IPI Bench (Li等,2026.),和StreamArena (Zhang等,2026.). 我们进一步评价军事工业公司的谈话启动和答复质量、南非技术合作公司的工具辅助问答、当地化和自愿终止妊娠的弃权。 我们开放了模型权重和推论代码的来源,以支持可再生的研究和实际应用.

blocks.en: The main contributions of our work are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的主要贡献概述如下。

blocks.en: • We introduce AURA 2.0 , a streaming VideoLLM with MIC as the key advance, enabling the model to identify topics worth discussing and initiate conversations at appropriate moments without a user query. SATC and IVG further extend its interaction capabilities while retaining Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA. • We construct a dedicated streaming interaction dataset covering MIC, SATC, and IVG by extending the streaming interaction dataset of AURA. The resulting dataset comprises approximately 11.4 billion tokens, 5,400 hours of video, and 40 million training frames. We adopt a three-stage training scheme with focal-loss-based supervision for response-control tokens to integrate the new behaviors with existing streaming interaction abilities. • We incorporate LHIM to maintain contextual continuity over extended video streams by preserving salient events as textual descriptions beyond the active visual window. We further optimize the streaming inference framework for low-latency deployment and timely interactions. • We demonstrate strong performance on public streaming benchmarks and validate AURA 2.0’s new interaction capabilities through targeted evaluations. We open-source the model weights and inference code to support reproducible research and practical applications.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Streaming Video LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 流取视频 LLMS

blocks.en: While offline VideoLLMs analyze complete video clips for comprehension, temporal reasoning, and task execution ( Team et al., 2024 ; Qwen Team, 2026b ; Google, 2026a ; ByteDance Seed, 2026a ) , streaming VideoLLMs process incoming observations incrementally and decide when to speak or remain silent using only the video observed so far. Early streaming works ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) introduce online perception and timely responses to incrementally arriving video. Within this setting, most systems remain query-driven : the user specifies a question or monitoring goal, and the model primarily decides when sufficient visual evidence has arrived to answer. AURA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) unifies Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA to support immediate, delayed, and multiple answers within one streaming framework. MMDuet2 ( Wang et al., 2025c ) learns speaking and silence decisions through multi-turn reinforcement learning, while Em-Garde ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) triggers answers when observations match visual conditions derived from a user query.
blocks.zh: 离线视频时 LLMS分析完整的视频剪辑,以了解,时间推理和任务执行(Team等,2024;Quen Team,2026b;Google,2026a;ByteDance种子,2026a),流传. 视频 LLMS 正在逐步处理收到的观测结果,并仅使用迄今为止观察到的视频决定何时发言或保持沉默。 早期溪流工程(Chen等,2024;张等. ; 2024; Chen等, 2025; Fu等, 2025; Yao等, 2025; Qian等, 2025; Wang等, 2025a) 引入了在线感知并及时回应渐进到来视频. 在这个背景下,大多数系统仍然是由查询驱动的:用户指定一个问题或监测目标,模型主要决定何时有足够的视觉证据来回答. AURA(Lu等,2026a)统一实时QA,主动QA,以及多响应QA,在一个流出框架内支持即时,延迟,多解答. MMDuet2(Wang等,2025c.)通过多回合强化学习来学习发言和沉默决定,而Em-Garde(Zheng等,2026.)则在观察与用户查询得出的视觉条件相匹配时触发答案.

blocks.en: Recent models further couple continuous perception with finer interaction control to support broader proactive behaviors such as standing instructions, alerts, live commentary, and scene-triggered reminders ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . JoyAI-VL-Interaction ( Yao et al., 2026b ) makes a learned decision each second to remain silent, respond, or delegate across time-aligned QA, alerting, and commentary using explicit silence/response tokens. MOSS-VL-Realtime ( Wang et al., 2026 ) uses gated cross-attention and per-frame silence/response tokens to incorporate newly arriving frames, allowing it to wait, continue speaking, or revise its response under standing instructions and commentary. MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) and SeedRealtime ( ByteDance Seed, 2026b ) align audiovisual and text streams end-to-end to regulate speaking timing and deliver proactive reminders or suggestions, while Qwen3.8-Omni (via Qwen-Live-Harness) ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) and Gemini Live ( Google, 2026d ; Google, 2026c ; Google, 2026b ) additionally support user-defined monitoring, proactive response withholding, and continuous audiovisual dialogue ( Qwen Team, 2025a ; Qwen Team, 2025b ; Hurst et al., 2024 ) . Streaming benchmarks assess complementary aspects of online understanding and proactive behavior ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Niu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2025d ) . However, across these settings, responses remain conditioned on prior user questions, standing instructions, or predefined monitoring rules, and, to our knowledge, no existing model is trained to initiate open-ended conversations without any prior request. AURA 2.0 bridges this gap by introducing Model-Initiated Conversation : rather than merely deciding when to respond to a user request, the model proactively discovers topics worth discussing from the evolving visual scene and conversational history, determining both what to discuss and when to initiate a conversation while remaining silent when appropriate.
blocks.zh: 近期的模型进一步将连续感知与更精细的交互控制结合,支持更广泛的主动行为,如站立指令,提示,活评论,和场景触发提醒(Yan等,2026). JoyAI-VL-Interact (Yao等, 2026b.)每秒都会做出一个有学问的决定, 保持缄默, 回应, MOSS-VL-Realtime(Wang等,2026年)使用门式交叉注意和每帧沉默/反应符号来收录新到的帧,允许它等待、继续发言或根据长期指示和评论修改其反应。 MiniCPM-o 4.5(Cui等,2026年)和SeedRealtime(ByteDance Seed,2026年b)对视听和文本流进行端到端对接,以规范发言时间,并主动发出提醒或建议;而Qune3.8-Omni(通过Qune-Live-Harness) (Quen Team, 2026c.)和双子座直播(Google, 2026d;Google, 2026c;Google, 2026b.)另外支持用户定义的监测,主动拒绝回应,并持续进行视听对话(Quen Team, 2025a;Quen Team, 2025b;Hurst等,2024.). 分流基准评估在线理解和主动行为的互补方面(Lin等,2024;Niu等,2025;Wang等,2025;Wang等,2025d). 然而,在所有这些背景下,答复仍以先前的用户问题、长期指示或预先界定的监测规则为条件,而且据我们所知,没有经过培训,在没有事先请求的情况下启动开放式对话。 AURA 2.0通过引入Model-Introduct Conversation来弥补这一差距: 而不是仅仅决定何时响应用户请求,模型主动地从不断发展的视觉场景和对话历史中发现了值得讨论的议题,决定了讨论的内容和何时启动对话,同时酌情保持沉默.

blocks.en: 2.2 Streaming Tool Calling and Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.2 流线工具呼叫和视地定位

blocks.en: Tool use extends streaming interaction beyond language responses by enabling models to access external information and execute tasks. JoyAI-VL-Interaction ( Yao et al., 2026b ) supports asynchronous task delegation to background models or agents while maintaining foreground interaction. Qwen-Live-Harness ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) connects real-time interaction with external agent backends, allowing conversations to continue during task execution. Gemini 3.8 Live ( Google, 2026b ) supports non-blocking function calls and configurable handling of returned results. SeedRealtime ( ByteDance Seed, 2026b ) incorporates tool use into live audiovisual interaction, while TML’s Interaction Models ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2026 ) explore the coordination of foreground interaction and background reasoning. These works demonstrate different approaches to integrating external capabilities into continuous interaction. Building on this direction, AURA 2.0 introduces Stream-Aware Tool Calling , which enables the model to determine when to invoke external tools, select appropriate tools, and formulate arguments based on evolving visual observations and conversational context. Tool results are then incorporated into subsequent responses, allowing external information to support ongoing streaming interactions.
blocks.zh: 工具使用通过使模型能够获取外部信息并执行任务,将流式交互扩展到语言响应之外. JoyAI-VL-Interactive(Yao等,2026b)支持同步任务授权给背景模型或代理,同时保持前缘互动. Quen-Live-Harness (Quen Team, 2026c) 连接了外部代理后端的实时交互,允许任务执行期间继续对话. 双子座 3.8 Live (Google, 2026b) 支持非屏蔽功能呼叫和可配置处理返回结果. 种子Realtime (ByteDance Seed, 2026b) 将工具使用融入了现场视听互动中,而TML的"互动模型"(Winking Machines Lab, 2026)则探索了前景互动和背景推理的协调. 这些工作显示了将外部能力纳入持续互动的不同方法。 基于这个方向,AURA 2.0引入了Stream-Aware Tool Calling .,这使得模型能够确定何时引用外部工具,选择适当的工具,并基于不断发展的视觉观察和对话上下文提出论据. 然后将工具结果纳入随后的回复,允许外部信息支持正在进行的流式互动.

blocks.en: Visual grounding connects language references to specific objects and regions in the visual scene. Existing vision-language models support object and region localization in images and videos ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . In streaming interactions, spatial grounding requires identifying and localizing relevant objects as new visual observations continuously arrive. AURA 2.0 introduces Interactive Visual Grounding , enabling the model to interpret user-provided visual prompts and generate frame-aligned bounding boxes for objects and regions referenced in its responses. This allows the model to connect ongoing conversations with specific visual elements in the observed scene.
blocks.zh: 视觉地平线连接了视觉场景中特定物体和区域的语言参考. 现有视觉语言模型支持图像和视频中的物体和区域本地化(Bai等人,2025b; Bai等,2025a;Wang等,2025b;Yang等,2025.). 在相流相互作用中,空间地平面要求随着新的视觉观测不断到来,确定相关物体并将其定位. AURA 2.0引入了交互式视觉地平线(Interactive Visual Grounding ),使该模型能够解释用户提供的视觉提示并生成针对其回复中引用的对象和区域的帧相接边框. 这使得模型能够将正在进行的对话与被观测到的场景中的特定视觉元素相接.

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the publicly reported interaction capabilities of representative streaming models. AURA 2.0 retains Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA while integrating MIC, SATC, and IVG within a unified streaming interaction framework.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了公开报告的有代表性流派模型的互动能力。 AURA 2.0保留了实时QA,主动QA,多响应QA,同时将MIC,SATC,IVG整合在一个统一的流互动框架内.

blocks.en: 3 AURA 2.0 Framework
blocks.zh: 3 AURA 2.0框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体结构

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of the AURA 2.0 streaming interaction framework. The model incrementally processes video chunks together with user inputs and interaction history, producing either <|silent|> for silent observation or <|respond|> followed by a text response or tool call.
Tool results are incorporated into the context to support subsequent responses.
Dashed outlines indicate historical messages beyond the active visual window.
blocks.zh:
图2:AURA 2.0流互动框架概述. 该模型将视频块与用户输入和互动历史一起渐进处理,生成用于静默观察的QQsilentQQ,或QQ对应QQ,然后是文本响应或工具呼叫.

blocks.en: AURA 2.0 largely follows the streaming architecture and context management mechanism of AURA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , as illustrated in Figure 2 . Incoming video is organized into temporal chunks and processed incrementally together with the available user inputs and interaction history. The context retains recent visual observations and textual interactions through sliding windows, allowing the model to continuously observe the video stream and determine whether to generate a response.
blocks.zh: AURA 2.0主要遵循AURA(Lu等人,2026a)的流体结构和上下文管理机制,如图2所示。 即将到来的视频被整理成时间块,并与可用的用户投入和互动历史一起逐步处理. 上下文通过滑动窗口保留了最近的视觉观测和文字互动,使模型能够持续地观测视频流并决定是否生成响应.

blocks.en: For each video chunk, the assistant outputs <|silent|> alone when it remains silent. When it decides to respond, it outputs <|respond|> followed by response content, which can contain a conversational utterance or a tool call. This format explicitly distinguishes silent observation from response generation and accommodates different interaction behaviors within the same chunk-wise structure.
blocks.zh: 每个视频块,助理输出 QQ silent QQ 当它保持沉默时 独自一人 当它决定响应时,它输出出QQ对应QQ,然后是响应内容,其中可以包含一个对话的言论或一个工具呼叫. 这种格式明确区分了静态观察和响应生成,并适应了同一块形结构内不同的相互作用行为.

blocks.en: The main architectural addition is the LHIM module, implemented using an auxiliary summarization model. This model processes visual content leaving the active visual window together with all textual context available at the time of summarization. It organizes the information at the event level and produces summaries in QA form. These QA pairs are inserted back into the interaction context, preserving information about past events after their visual observations are no longer available. By incorporating both visual and textual information, LHIM provides historical context for subsequent responses and conversation initiation. Its implementation and integration into streaming inference are described in Section 6.1 .
blocks.zh: 主要建筑外加是LHIM模块,使用辅助归纳模型实施. 这个模型处理视觉内容,将活动视觉窗口与归纳时所有可用的文字上下文放在一起. 它在活动一级组织信息,并以质量保证形式编写摘要。 这些QA对被重新插入到交互上下文中,在视觉观察不再可用后保存关于过去事件的信息. LHIM通过既包含视觉信息,也包含文字信息,为后续的响应和对话启动提供了历史背景. 第6.1节介绍了其执行情况和融入流推论的情况。

blocks.en: 3.2 Streaming Interaction Capabilities
blocks.zh: 3.2 流动相互作用能力

blocks.en: The chunk-wise interaction format supports both user-driven responses and model-initiated conversations. AURA 2.0 retains Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA from AURA, while extending its capabilities with MIC, SATC, and IVG.
blocks.zh: 块式交互格式既支持用户驱动的响应,也支持模型启动的对话. AURA 2.0保留了来自AURA的实时QA,主动QA,以及多响应QA,同时将其能力扩展至MIC,SATC,和IVG.

blocks.en: MIC enables the model to identify topics worth discussing in the evolving visual stream and initiate conversations when no new user query is present. The model determines whether an event warrants discussion, when to speak, and what to say based on both visual observations and the preceding conversational context. Previously discussed content informs these decisions to avoid repetitive or unnecessary interruptions. MIC is naturally accommodated by the existing interaction format. The user-text field for the corresponding chunk is empty, while the assistant generates <|respond|> followed by its utterance. An empty user-text field alone does not distinguish MIC from a deferred response. MIC initiates a conversational turn on the model’s own initiative rather than answering a pending user query or carrying out a previously requested reminder.
blocks.zh: MIC使模型能够识别在不断发展的视觉流中值得讨论的专题,并在没有新的用户查询时启动对话. 该模型决定某项活动是否值得讨论,何时发言,以及根据视觉观察和前述对话背景应说什么。 以前讨论的内容告知这些决定,以避免重复或不必要的中断。 多边投资中心自然由现有的互动格式所容纳。 对应块的用户文本字段是空的, 而助手生成 QQ 对应 QQ , 然后是其语句 。 仅一个空的用户文本字段并不能区分MIC和延迟响应. MIC主动启动对话,而不是回答用户的询问或执行以前要求的提醒。

blocks.en: SATC enables the model to invoke external tools using the current visual and conversational context to obtain information beyond its own knowledge. Tool calls are represented as response content following <|respond|> , so the same response-control mechanism governs both conversational utterances and tool invocations. Returned information is incorporated into the ongoing interaction to support subsequent responses.
blocks.zh: SATC使模型能够利用当前的视觉和对话上下文来引用外部工具来获取超出自身所知的信息. 工具调用作为响应内容在QQ对应QQ之后被表示,所以同样的响应控制机制既规范了对话言论,也规范了工具引用. 反馈的信息被纳入正在进行的互动,以支持随后的反应。

blocks.en: IVG supports visual reference in both user inputs and model outputs. Users can mark objects or regions in video frames to specify what they refer to, and the model can associate its responses with visual targets by outputting frame-aligned bounding boxes. Each box is expressed in the standard coordinate format [ x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ] [x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}] within the response content. This representation allows localization information to be conveyed through the same output format used for other responses.
blocks.zh: IVG支持在用户输入和模型输出中进行可视化参考. 用户可以在视频帧中标记对象或区域来指定它们所指的内容,而该模型可以通过输出帧相接的边框将其反应与可视目标联系起来. 每个框在响应内容内以标准坐标格式[x 1, y 1, x 2, y 2] [x_{1}, y_{1}, x_{2},y_{2}]表示. 这种表示方式使得本地化信息能够通过其他响应所使用的相同的输出格式来传递.

blocks.en: 4 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 页:1 数据构建

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Construction Pipeline

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the AURA 2.0 data pipeline extends AURA’s streaming interaction data with three new forms of supervision: MIC, SATC, and IVG. It proceeds from video preparation to task-specific synthesis and finally to streaming assembly and quality verification. Source videos are re-encoded, resized, and divided into clips; an MLLM generates clip-level descriptions of objects, actions, and scene context. These descriptions support the construction of the inherited streaming QA tasks and the three new interaction types. The synthesized trajectories are aligned to video chunks so that queries, silent observations, responses, tool calls, and bounding boxes are represented along a consistent timeline.
blocks.zh: 如图3所显示的,AURA 2.0数据管道将AURA的流式交互数据扩展为三种新的监督形式:MIC,SATC,和IVG. 它从录相准备开始,进行针对具体任务的合成,最后进行流组装和质量核查。 源视频被重新编码,调整大小,并被分为片段;一个MLLM生成片段对对象,动作,和场景背景的描述. 这些描述支持了对所继承的流式QA任务和三种新互动类型的构建. 被合成的轨迹与视频块对齐,这样,查询,静音观测,回复,工具呼叫,和边框都按照一致的时间表来表示.

(1) Video collection and preparation standardizes videos into clips and generates clip-level descriptions.
(2) Task-specific data synthesis uses the clips and descriptions to construct General QA, MIC, SATC, and IVG trajectories.
(3) Streaming assembly and quality assessment aligns the trajectories to video chunks and filters invalid or low-quality samples.

blocks.en: MIC data. We construct MIC training data by asking an MLLM to determine when to initiate a conversation and what to say. For each video, the MLLM generates zero or more conversation openings, each consisting of a timestamp and a short message. Each opening must be supported by visual observations available up to that timestamp. When preceding dialogue is available from the data-construction process, the MLLM also uses it to select topics relevant to the user’s expressed interests and avoid repeating earlier discussions. Possible openings include drawing attention to a visual detail, offering a timely alert, providing contextual information, or suggesting a relevant activity. The prompt encourages useful contributions and discourages unsupported claims and unnecessary interruptions.

blocks.en: SATC data. We combine real execution records with MLLM-generated tool-calling traces to teach the model when and how to use external information. Each trajectory includes the tool-call arguments, the returned result, and the subsequent response. To encourage selective tool use, we add one to four randomly selected tool schemas to 50% of non-tool-calling streaming samples while retaining their original targets. These examples teach the model to respond or remain silent without invoking a tool, even when tools are available.
blocks.zh: SATC数据. 我们把真实的行刑记录与MLLM生成的工具调用痕迹结合起来,以教导模型何时以及如何使用外部信息. 每个轨迹包括工具调用参数,返回的结果,以及随后的反应. 为了鼓励选择性工具的使用,我们在50%的非工具调用流体样本中增加了1到4个随机选择的工具计划,同时保留其原始目标. 这些例子教导模型在不使用工具的情况下,即使有工具可用,也要作出反应或保持沉默.

An MLLM rewrites the annotations into streaming grounding interactions, retaining available bounding-box coordinates and aligning them with their corresponding video frames.
The data cover six patterns: responses with boxes, multi-candidate disambiguation, subjective selection with an explanation, multi-turn follow-up and target switching, box-only tracking, and target-absent responses.

blocks.en: We apply structural checks and task-specific MLLM verification to filter synthesized trajectories. Structural checks ensure chronological consistency and correct alignment between bounding boxes and video frames. MLLM validators assess whether responses are supported by the available visual evidence and occur at appropriate times, using relevant video history for memory-related QA. MIC openings are reviewed for timing and scene consistency using clips extending five seconds beyond the proposed initiation time. For IVG, bounding boxes are rendered on the corresponding frames to verify target correctness. Samples that fail these checks are excluded from training.
blocks.zh: 我们采用结构检查和任务特定的MLLM验证来过滤被合成的轨迹. 结构检查确保了相框和相框之间的时间顺序一致性并正确调整. MLLM验证器使用相关视频历史进行与内存相关的QA,评估答复是否得到现有视觉证据的支持并适时发生. 利用超过拟议启动时间5秒钟的短片,对军事工业中心的开口时间和场景的一致性进行审查。 对于IVG,在相应的帧上会制取边框来验证目标正确性. 未通过这些检查的样本被排除在培训之外。

blocks.en: 4.2 Dataset Composition and Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集的组成和统计

blocks.en: The verified training mixture retains Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA alongside MIC, SATC, IVG, and mixed-capability data. Across the three training stages, it comprises 484,459 samples and 11.43 billion tokens, covering about 5,400 hours of video and 40 million training frames. The sample and token counts include replayed examples across stages and should not be interpreted as numbers of distinct source videos.
blocks.zh: 经核实的训练混合物保留了实时质量评估、主动性质量评估以及多反应质量评估,同时保留了MIC、SATC、IVG和混合能力数据。 在三个培训阶段,它包括484 459个样本和114.3亿个信使,涵盖大约5 400小时的视频和4 000万个培训框架。 样本和标语计数包括不同阶段的重播实例,不应被解释为不同源视频的数量。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 4 , the inherited query-driven tasks remain the largest part of the sample distribution: Real-Time QA accounts for 34.2%, Proactive QA for 22.1%, and Multi-Response QA for 12.4%. These samples provide supervision for immediate answers, delayed responses when sufficient evidence becomes available, and multiple responses to a single user query, respectively. The newly introduced data cover MIC (11.8%), IVG (9.8%), SATC (5.3%), and mixed-capability examples (4.5%). These data extend supervision to conversation initiation, visual reference, selective tool use, and capability composition, while retaining supervision for the existing QA tasks.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,遗留下来的由查询驱动的任务仍然是样本分布的最大部分: 实时QA占34.2%,主动QA占22.1%,多响应QA占12.4%. 这些样本为立即答复提供监督,在获得充分证据后延迟答复,以及分别对单一用户查询的多份答复。 新引入的数据包括:MIC(11.8%)、IVG(9.8%)、SATC(5.3%)和混合能力实例(4.5%)。 这些数据将监督范围扩大到对话启动、视觉参考、选择性工具使用和能力组成,同时保留对现有质量保证任务的监督。

blocks.en: The three stages account for 51.6%, 33.9%, and 14.5% of samples, compared with 49.4%, 30.5%, and 20.0% of tokens, respectively. Stage 3 therefore has a greater token share than sample share, indicating a higher average token count per sample. The rationale for the stage-wise task mixtures is discussed in Section 5.1 . Silent observations dominate the response-control targets in all three stages (96.3%, 94.9%, and 96.7%). This imbalance motivates the response-control objective in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 这三个阶段分别占样品的51.6%、33.9%和14.5%,而分别占49.4%、30.5%和20.7%。 因此,第三阶段的象征性份额大于抽样份额,表明每个抽样的平均象征性数目较高。 第5.1节讨论了分阶段任务混合物的理由。 在所有三个阶段(96.3%、94.9%和96.7%),静静观测都占据了反应控制目标的主导地位。 这种不平衡现象推动了第5.2节中的反应控制目标。

blocks.en: 5 Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 5 培训战略

blocks.en: AURA 2.0 is initialized from Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) and follows the streaming interaction architecture of AURA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) . Training must preserve AURA’s existing response behavior while introducing MIC, SATC, and IVG. Because these capabilities change both response timing and output format, we introduce them progressively rather than learning all behaviors from a single mixture.
blocks.zh: AURA 2.0由Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026a.)初始化而来,并沿用了AURA(Lu等,2026a.)的溪流互动架构. 训练必须保留AURA现有的反应行为, 因为这些能力既改变了反应时间,也改变了输出格式,所以我们逐渐地引入它们,而不是从单一的混合物中学习出所有的行为.

blocks.en: 5.1 Three-Stage Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 5.1 三阶段培训战略

blocks.en: Our three-stage curriculum first establishes general streaming interaction and tool use, then introduces MIC and IVG with replay of earlier tasks, and finally trains on examples that combine multiple capabilities. This progression aims to integrate new behaviors without degrading the existing response policy. Figure 4 shows the stage-wise sample and token distributions; the token-level task ratios and their roles in each stage are detailed below. Each stage is trained for one epoch, with Stage 1 initialized from Qwen3.5-9B and subsequent stages initialized from the preceding stage.
blocks.zh: 我们的"三阶段"课程首先建立通流交互和工具使用,再引入MIC和IVG并重放更早的任务,最后对结合多种能力的例子进行培训. 这一进展旨在整合新的行为,同时不贬低现行应对政策。 图4显示分阶段抽样和象征性分布;每个阶段的象征性任务比率及其作用详述如下。 每个阶段都接受一个时代的培训,第一阶段从Quen3.5-9B开始初始化,随后各阶段从前一阶段开始初始化。

blocks.en: The first stage contains approximately 250k samples and 5.65B tokens, of which 87.2% come from general streaming QA and 12.8% from SATC. General streaming QA comprises Real-Time QA, Proactive QA, and Multi-Response QA, covering immediate, delayed, and continuous responses to user queries. Together, these data establish a basic response policy in which the model remains silent while observing, responds when sufficient evidence is available, and produces multiple updates when needed. SATC is included at this stage to enable the model to determine when and how to use tools based on user requests and the evolving visual and conversational context.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段包含约250克样本和5.65B个令牌,其中87.2%来自一般溪流QA,12.8%来自SATC. 一般流化QA包括实时QA,主动QA,以及多响应QA,涵盖对用户询问的即时,延迟和连续回复. 这些数据共同确立了一种基本的应对政策,即模型在观察时保持沉默,在有充分证据时作出反应,并在需要时产生多种更新。 将SATC纳入这一阶段,以使模型能够根据用户请求以及不断发展的视觉和对话背景确定何时和如何使用工具。

blocks.en: The second stage contains approximately 164k samples and 3.49B tokens. Data retained from Stage 1 account for 65.3% of the tokens, while MIC and IVG account for 25.7% and 8.9%, respectively. In the MIC data, model responses are aligned with relevant visual evidence to supervise both response timing and content. IVG introduces bounding-box tokens for visually grounded references. Retaining earlier data helps prevent the new tasks from increasing unnecessary responses, producing bounding boxes in ordinary answers, or degrading previously learned behaviors.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段包含约164克样本和3.49B令牌. 从第一阶段保留的数据占信使的65.3%,而MIC和IVG分别占25.7%和8.9%。 在MIC数据中,模型反应与相关的视觉证据一致,以监督反应时间和内容. IVG为可视化的参考文献引入了边框符号. 保留更早的数据有助于防止新任务增加不必要的响应,在普通答案中产生边框,或者贬低以前学到的行为.

blocks.en: The final stage contains approximately 70k samples and 2.29B tokens. Mixed-capability data account for 34.9% of the tokens, MIC for 46.5%, Proactive QA for 13.3%, and IVG for 5.4%. Examples that combine capabilities, such as Proactive QA with SATC and MIC with SATC, teach the model to coordinate response timing, tool use, and model-initiated interaction within the same trajectory. To further refine when the model should engage, some Proactive QA examples supervise silence when an event is irrelevant or a response would be repetitive.
blocks.zh: 最终阶段包含约70克样本和2.29B令牌. 混合能力数据占信使的34.9%,MIC占46.5%,主动质量评估占13.3%,IVG占5.4%。 将能力结合起来的例子,例如积极主动的QA和SATC以及MIC和SATC, 教导模型协调反应时间、工具使用以及模型在相同轨迹内启动的相互作用。 为了进一步完善模型应何时使用,一些积极主动的质量保证实例监督某一事件无关紧要或反应重复时的沉默。

blocks.en: 6 Streaming Inference and Long-Horizon Memory
blocks.zh: 6 流线推论和长视野记忆

blocks.en: AURA 2.0 largely inherits the asynchronous streaming inference pipeline of AURA ( Lu et al., 2026a ) , integrating incremental video processing, context management, Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), and Text-to-Speech (TTS). It retains <|silent|> for silent observation and introduces <|respond|> before each non-silent response. Conversational text is passed to TTS, tool calls are executed with results returned to the model, and bounding boxes are rendered on the frontend. We further integrate LHIM to preserve historical information and optimize inference latency, as detailed in the following two subsections.
blocks.zh: AURA 2.0基本上继承了AURA(Lu等,2026a.)的同步流出推论管道,融合了增量视频处理,上下文管理,自动语音识别(ASR)和Text-to-Speech(TTS). 它保留了QQsilentQQ静默观察,并在每个非静默反应之前引入了QQ对应X. 对话文本被传递到TTS,工具调用被执行,结果返回到模型,并在前端提供边框. 我们进一步整合LHIM,以保存历史信息并优化推论延迟,详见以下两分节.

blocks.en: 6.1 Long-Horizon Interaction Memory
blocks.zh: 6.1 长视野相互作用记忆

blocks.en:
To support long-horizon streaming video understanding without continuously increasing the visual context, AURA 2.0 employs LHIM, a hierarchical event memory that compresses historical video observations into timestamped textual descriptions.
The context is organized into two components: a sliding window that preserves the most recent 30 seconds of video and the associated dialogue, and a context history that stores compressed visual memories alongside earlier question-answer interactions.
Video preceding the sliding window is divided into 30-second slices and processed by a separate summarization MLLM.
Given uniformly sampled frames and the associated dialogue as reference, the MLLM partitions each slice into semantically coherent events.
Each event contains start and end timestamps and a concise description of the salient visual information.
Event timestamps are converted to absolute session times. The events from each 30-second slice form a level-1 memory record, which is stored as a text-only QA pair in the context history.
blocks.zh:
为了在不持续增加视觉上下文的情况下支持长相流线视频理解,AURA 2.0采用了LHIM,这种分级事件记忆将历史视频观测压缩成有时间戳的文字描述.
上下文分为两部分:一是保存了最近30秒视频和相关对话的滑动窗口;一是将压缩的视觉记忆与先前的问答互动一起存储的上下文历史.
滑动窗口前的视频被分出30秒切出,再由单独的汇总MLLM处理.
由于采用了统一的抽样框架和相关对话作为参考,MLLM分区将每个部分分入整体一致的事件.
每个活动都包含起止时间戳和突出视觉信息的简洁描述.
事件时间戳转换为绝对会话时间. 从每30秒切出的事件组成了一级内存记录,在上下文历史中作为只收文本的QA对被存储.

blocks.en:
As the session progresses, older records are progressively merged into coarser summaries.
At each memory update, adjacent level-1 records are merged in pairs into level-2 summaries when these records end at least five minutes before the update time.
Adjacent level-2 records are similarly merged into level-3 summaries after ten minutes.
Each merged record preserves the combined time span and key visual information while reducing temporal detail.
Level-3 records remain in the context rather than being discarded to free capacity, while dialogue within the window remains aligned with its corresponding video chunks.
Together, these mechanisms maintain a fixed 30-second visual context, preserve recent history at event resolution, and retain older observations as progressively more compact text tied to absolute session time.
blocks.zh:
随着会议的进展,更古老的记录逐渐被合并为较短的摘要.
在每次内存更新时,相邻的一级记录被一对合并为二级摘要,当这些记录在更新时间前至少5分钟结束.
相邻的二级记录在十分钟后同样被合并为三级摘要.
每个合并记录都保留了合并的时间跨度和关键视觉信息,同时减少时间细节.
三级记录仍保留在上下文中,而不是被丢弃到免费容量,而窗口内的对话仍与其相应的视频块保持一致.
这些机制共同保持了30秒固定的可视环境,在事件解答时保留了近代历史,并保留了与绝对会话时间相挂钩的更紧凑的旧意见。

blocks.en: 6.2 Inference Latency Optimization
blocks.zh: 6.2 推断优化

blocks.en: We serve AURA 2.0 with vLLM-Omni ( vLLM-Omni Team, 2026 ) . Each turn is triggered either by a new video chunk or by a user query and is processed as a single request, which passes through four stages: speech recognition, MLLM inference, speech synthesis, and codec decoding (waveform generation). If a new turn begins with <|respond|> while the previous response is still being spoken, the ongoing response is interrupted and replaced by the new one; the full text of the interrupted response is retained in the dialogue history. Turns that output <|silent|> do not affect ongoing speech. We introduce three optimizations to this pipeline, and Section 7.6 evaluates the contribution of each.
blocks.zh: 我们用VLLM-Omni(vLLM-Omni Team, 2026)服务AURA 2. 每个转弯由新的视频块或用户查询所触发,并作为单一请求处理,通过四个阶段:语音识别,MLLM推论,语音合成,和编码解码(波形生成). 如果在之前的回音还在发音时以QQ对应QQ开始新的回音,则持续回音被中断并取而代之;中断回音的全文被保留在对话历史中. 转换输出 QQ silent QQ 不影响正在进行的演讲 。 我们对这一管道进行了三次优化,第7.6节评价了每个管道的贡献。

blocks.en: Session history. Each request carries only the frames of the current video chunk. The server decodes these frames into pixel arrays once and caches them, together with the dialogue, in a per-session history that mirrors the sliding window of Section 6.1 . When constructing the input of the next turn, the cached arrays are reused in their original order, so earlier frames are neither retransmitted by the client nor decoded again by the server. When context truncation removes video chunks from the sliding window, the corresponding arrays are evicted from the history, which keeps its size bounded by the window length. In addition, prefix caching reuses the KV cache of the unchanged context prefix across turns, so only newly appended frames and dialogue require prefill; the cache is rebuilt after each truncation.
blocks.zh: 会话历史. 每个请求只包含当前视频块的帧. 服务器一次将这些框架解码为像素阵列,并与对话框一起缓存到每段历史中,以镜像6.1节的滑动窗口. 在构建下个转弯的输入时,被缓存的阵列按原顺序被再用,因此更早的帧既不由客户端再发送,也不由服务器再解码. 当上下文切除从滑动窗口中去除视频块时,相应的数组会被从历史中移除,从而保持其大小被窗口长度所限制. 此外,前缀缓存再利用未变的上下文前缀的KV缓存横跨转折,所以只有新附框和对话框需要预填;缓存在每次截取后重建.

blocks.en: Fast paths for silent input and silent output. For turns triggered by a video chunk without user speech, speech recognition is skipped, and an empty transcript is passed to the MLLM together with the frames. On the output side, the first generated token determines the path: a <|silent|> token ends the turn after a single decoding step, without running speech synthesis or codec decoding. Only turns that begin with <|respond|> proceed to speech synthesis. Tool calls and bounding boxes are removed from the text stream before it reaches speech synthesis, and a turn that contains only a tool call does not invoke speech synthesis.

Sentence-level speech handoff. Speech synthesis starts before the MLLM finishes generating the full response. Generated text is split at sentence and clause boundaries, and completed segments are forwarded to speech synthesis once they total at least 15 tokens; shorter segments are buffered and merged with the following ones. All text of a turn is appended to a single streaming speech synthesis request, which remains open while generation continues.
blocks.zh: 句子级演讲交接. 语音合成开始于MLLM完成产生完整响应之前. 生成的文本在句子和条款边界上被分出,完成的片段在总计至少15个符后被传送到语音合成;较短的片段被缓冲并被与以下部分合并. 转弯后的所有文字都附加在单一流体语音综合请求上,在生成持续的同时,该请求仍然开放.

blocks.en: 7 Experiments
blocks.zh: 7个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate AURA 2.0 from three perspectives: streaming interaction performance, newly introduced interaction capabilities, and inference efficiency. After describing the evaluation settings (Section 7.1 ), we report results on four public benchmarks that assess response timing, event understanding, proactive task management, historical reasoning, tool use, and the coordination of reactive and proactive interactions (Section 7.2 ). We then conduct targeted evaluations of MIC, SATC, and IVG to assess model-initiated conversations, the contribution of external tools to answer accuracy, and visual localization, respectively (Sections 7.3 – 7.5 ). Finally, we measure response latency under concurrent sessions and analyze the effects of the serving optimizations (Section 7.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从三个角度评价AURA 2.0:流动互动性能,新引入的互动能力和推论效率. 在描述评价环境(第7.1节)之后,我们报告四个公共基准的结果,这些基准评估反应时间、事件了解、主动任务管理、历史推理、工具使用和协调被动和主动互动(第7.2节)。 然后,我们对MIC、SATC和IVG进行目标明确的评估,分别评估模型启动的对话、外部工具对回答准确性的贡献以及视觉本地化(第7.3至7.5节)。 最后,我们在同时开会时衡量反应的延迟性并分析服务优化的效果(第7.6节)。

blocks.en: 7.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.1 实验设置

blocks.en: AURA 2.0 processes incoming video incrementally in one-second chunks, with frame sampling governed by the benchmark-specific protocol below. The model maintains a 30-second sliding visual window together with textual interaction history and uses only information available up to the current step. User messages are inserted at their annotated timestamps, and previous user messages and generated responses are retained as textual context after their frames leave the visual window.
blocks.zh: AURA 2.0 处理以一秒块递增方式传送的视频,帧采样由以下具体基准协议管辖. 该模型保持了30秒的滑动视觉窗口并配有文字交互历史,并只使用到当前步骤为止的现有信息. 用户信息被插入到其附加说明的时间戳上,之前的用户信息和生成的响应在框架离开视觉窗口后作为文字上下文被保留.

blocks.en: IPIBench. For JoyAI-VL-Interaction, MOSS-VL-Realtime, and AURA 2.0, we process videos at 1 FPS with a 30-second visual context window. The models decide whether to remain silent or respond at every step. Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-9B-thinking are evaluated separately using the official offline inference pipeline, with their visual context extended to 30 frames. We follow the official scoring protocol and report subtask accuracies together with the arithmetic mean of the subtask scores within each category.
blocks.zh: IPI Bench. 对于JoyAI-VL-Interaction,MOSS-VL-Realtime,和AURA 2.0,我们处理视频在1 FPS,可视上下文窗口为30秒. 模型决定是保持沉默还是每一步响应. Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.5-9B-思考分别使用官能离线推导管进行评价,其视觉上下文被扩展至30帧. 我们遵循正式的评分协议,报告子任务速率,以及每个类别中子任务分数的算术平均值.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , AURA 2.0 demonstrates strong proactive interaction capabilities.
In Proactive Monitoring, AURA 2.0 achieves a Timing accuracy of 49.30%, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemini 3 Pro, while approaching GPT-4o (50.59%).
It also achieves 17.92% in Repeated Proactiveness, approaching the strongest published baseline, Gemini 3 Pro (18.40%).
AURA 2.0 achieves the highest Proactive Task Management average among all evaluated models, including proprietary ones.
It achieves 37.96% in Cancellation, approaching GPT-5.4 (38.43%), and obtains a Multi-task Management accuracy of 17.87%, exceeding Gemini 2.5 Pro and GPT-5.4.
These results suggest that AURA 2.0 is effective at maintaining multiple concurrent proactive objectives and suppressing obsolete actions when tasks are cancelled.
For Interleaved Reactive–Proactive Interaction, AURA 2.0 achieves 24.10% on R2P, 11.74% on RuP, and 18.65% on RaP. Its R2P performance is comparable to that of Gemini 3 Pro (24.76%).

blocks.en:
We supplement the published StreamArena results with our own evaluations of three open-source streaming models: JoyAI-VL-Interaction, MOSS-VL-Realtime, and AURA 2.0.
StreamArena consists of 243 videos and evaluates streaming video understanding across four dimensions:
Real-Time Perception (RTP) measures the ability to answer questions about the current video content in real time,
Historical Retrospection (HR) evaluates the ability to retrieve and reason about historical visual information across four temporal horizons (L1–L4),
External Tool Use (Tool) assesses the ability to invoke external tools for tasks requiring additional information or capabilities,
and Proactive Interaction (Pro) evaluates whether a model can proactively respond when a specified event occurs, while remaining silent before the event.
All results are reported as accuracies (%), following the official StreamArena evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh:
我们用我们自己对三个开源流模式的评价来补充已公布的流源流结果: JoyAI-VL-Interactive,MOSS-VL-Realtime,和AURA 2.0.
StreamArena由243个视频组成,并评价四维的流媒体理解:
实时感知(RTP)测量实时解答当前视频内容问题的能力,
历史回想(HR)评价了跨越四个时间范围(L1-L4)的历史视觉信息检索和理性的能力.
外部工具使用(工具)评估了为需要额外信息或能力的任务而援引外部工具的能力,
和"主动互动"(Pro)评价一个模型能否在被指定事件发生时主动响应,同时在事件发生前保持沉默.
所有结果都按照正式的StreamArena评价协议报告为速率(%)。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , AURA 2.0 achieves 28.5% in Real-Time Perception and 24.5% in Historical Retrospection, outperforming JoyAI-VL-Interaction and MOSS-VL-Realtime on both dimensions. Its accuracy on the longest historical horizon (L4) reaches 17.0%, exceeding AURA and the other listed open-source streaming models. The largest gain over AURA is in Proactive Interaction, where accuracy increases from 3.7% to 12.8%, also surpassing JoyAI-VL-Interaction (9.4%) and MOSS-VL-Realtime (11.8%). In particular, L1 accuracy rises from 8.9% to 29.7%. For External Tool Use, AURA 2.0 achieves 18.5%, surpassing JoyAI-VL-Interaction (12.2%) and MiniCPM-o 4.5 (17.1%).
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,AURA 2.0在实时感知中达到28.5%,在历史回想中达到24.5%,在两个维度上均优于JoyAI-VL-Interactive和MOSS-VL-Realtime. 它在最长历史地平线(L4)上的精度达到17.0%,超过了AURA和其他列出的开源流模型. 与AURA相比最大的收益是主动互动,精确度从3.7%提高到12.8%,也超过了JoyAI-VL-Interaction(9.4%)和MOSS-VL-Realtime(11.8%). 尤其是L1精度从8.9%上升到29.7%. 对于外部工具的使用,AURA 2.0实现18.5%,超过了JoyAI-VL-Interaction(12.2%)和MiniCPM-o 4.5(17.1%).

Alongside the baselines from the ProactiveVideoQA paper, we report the performance of JoyAI-VL-Interaction, MOSS-VL-Realtime, and AURA 2.0.
The results for MOSS-VL-Realtime are taken from its official technical report, which only provides scores at ω = 0.5 \omega=0.5 .
ProactiveVideoQA consists of 1,427 videos across four categories: Web Videos (WEB), Egocentric Videos (EGO), TV Series (TV), and Video Anomaly Detection (VAD).
WEB evaluates general video understanding, while EGO focuses on first-person visual understanding in daily activities.
TV assesses the comprehension of dialogue and social relationships, whereas VAD evaluates the ability to detect and report abnormal events in surveillance videos.
All results are reported using Proactive Area Under Curve (PAUC), which jointly measures response correctness and timeliness.
Specifically, the parameter ω \omega controls the relative importance of response timing and content correctness.
At ω = 0 \omega=0 , the metric emphasizes timely responses, while ω = 1 \omega=1 evaluates response correctness without considering timing.
The default setting ω = 0.5 \omega=0.5 balances these two aspects.

WEB评价一般视频理解,而EGO则注重日常活动中的第一人称视觉理解.
电视评估对话和社会关系的理解,而VAD则评估监视视频中发现和报告异常事件的能力.

默认设置 QQ = 0.5\omega = 0.5 平衡这两个方面.

As shown in Table 4 , AURA 2.0 demonstrates strong proactive video understanding capabilities across all four categories.
Under the default ω = 0.5 \omega=0.5 setting, it achieves PAUC scores of 58.8, 53.1, 49.3, and 41.8 on WEB, EGO, TV, and VAD, respectively.

These results highlight the effectiveness of AURA 2.0 in proactive video understanding, particularly in general web-video comprehension, where it achieves the best WEB score among all listed models at every ω \omega .

blocks.en: 7.2.4 Evaluation on PhoStream
blocks.zh: 7.2.4 对PhoStream的评价

blocks.en:
Beyond the models covered in the PhoStream paper, we further evaluate Qwen3.5-9B, JoyAI-VL-Interaction, MOSS-VL-Realtime, and AURA 2.0.
PhoStream is a mobile-centric streaming video understanding benchmark containing 578 videos and 5,572 open-ended questions across diverse real-world scenarios.
It evaluates three types of temporal understanding: Instant, Backward, and Forward.
Instant measures the ability to answer questions based on the current video content, while Backward evaluates the retrieval and reasoning of previously observed information.
Forward assesses whether a model can continuously monitor the video stream and respond only when sufficient evidence becomes available in the future.
The Overall score is computed as the question-weighted average across the three task categories.
For Forward tasks, we further report Early Response (ER), No Response (NR), and Partly Correct (PC).
blocks.zh:
除了PhoStream论文所涵盖的模型外,我们进一步评价了Quen3.5-9B,JoyAI-VL-Interaction,MOSS-VL-Realtime,以及AURA 2.0.
PhoStream是一个以移动为中心进行流媒体理解的视频基准,包含578个视频和5,572个不同现实世界情景的开放式问题.
它评价了三种时间理解:即时,后向和前向.
即时测量根据当前视频内容回答问题的能力,而后向评价先前所观察到信息的检索和推理.
前期评估一个模型能否持续地监测视频流,并只有在将来有足够的证据时才能做出回应.
总体分数作为三个任务类别中的问题加权平均数来计算。
关于前进任务,我们进一步报告早期反应、无反应和部分正确。

blocks.en:
Table 5 shows that AURA 2.0 achieves the highest reported Overall score of 65.69, exceeding the strongest proprietary baseline, Doubao-Seed-1.8, by 9.54 points.
It leads the open-source streaming models on all three tasks, scoring 77.89 on Instant, 71.48 on Backward, and 56.22 on Forward.
Its largest advantage lies in Forward reasoning, where it exceeds MOSS-VL-Realtime by 37.95 points.
This improvement is accompanied by the lowest Early Response rate among all listed models, at 1.30%, compared with 41.51% for MOSS-VL-Realtime, 94.93% for JoyAI-VL-Interaction, and 66.52% for Qwen3.5-9B.
AURA 2.0 also achieves the highest Partly Correct rate of 74.80%, indicating that a larger proportion of responses fall within the valid response window; this category reflects response timing rather than guaranteed semantic correctness.
Its No Response rate remains 23.90%, highlighting missed responses as a remaining limitation.
blocks.zh:
表5显示,AURA 2.0的总得分达到所报最高的65.69分,超过最强的专利基线"杜宝-种子-1.8",得分9.54分.
它在所有三项任务中都领导开源流线模型,在"即时"(Instant)评分为77.89分,在"后行"评分为71.48分,在"前行"评分为56.22分.
其最大优势在于前进推理,它比MOSS-VL-Realtime超过37.95分.
与此同时,所有上市型号的早期反应率最低,为1.30%,而最低业务安全标准-VL-Realtime为41.51%,JoyAI-VL-Interaction为94.93%,Quen3.5-9B为66.52%。
AURA 2.0还实现了74.80%的最高部分正确率,表明较大比例的响应属于有效响应窗口;这一类反映了响应时间,而不是保证语义正确.
其未答复率仍为23.90%,突出显示未答复是剩余的限制。

blocks.en: 7.3 Evaluation of Model-Initiated Conversation
blocks.zh: 7.3 评价模式启动的对话

blocks.en: We evaluate MIC on MIC-Bench, an internal benchmark. It contains 25 videos evaluated under two settings, yielding 50 test instances. The Visual-Dialogue Context setting tests whether the model can identify opportunities to build on a prior dialogue, while the Visual-Only Context setting tests whether it can identify topics worth discussing from visual observations alone. No new user queries are provided during playback in either setting.
blocks.zh: 我们用军事工业公司本奇评估军事工业公司,这是内部基准。 它包含在两个设置下评价的25个视频,产生了50个测试实例. Visual-Dial-Conference设置测试该模型是否能够识别在之前的对话基础上发展的机会,而Visual-Only Contference设置测试其是否能够识别值得单独从视觉观察中讨论的主题. 在两个设置的回放过程中都未提供新的用户查询 。

blocks.en: We report trigger rate , the percentage of evaluation units (annotated windows or full videos) containing at least one nonempty model-initiated message, and response quality , which measures the value of those messages. To reflect interruption cost, we also report the number of messages per minute over the entire playback, taking the median across videos. An MLLM judge ( gpt-4o ) receives the conversational context (when available), the model-initiated message, and two video frames in chronological order, sampled one second before and at message onset. Two annotators reviewed all judge outputs and found no unreasonable judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们报告触发率、至少包含一个非空模式启动的信息的评价单位(附加说明的窗口或完整视频)的百分比以及衡量这些信息价值的反应质量。 为了反映中断成本,我们还报告整个回放中每分钟的信息数量,在视频中取中位数。 一名MLLM法官(gpt-4o)收到对话上下文(如果有的话),模型启动的信息,以及按时间顺序排列的两个视频帧,在消息发出之前和消息发出时抽取了一秒钟。 两名注释员审查了所有法官的产出,发现没有不合理的判决。

blocks.en: Visual-Dialogue Context. The model receives a short prior conversation expressing a user need, interest, or concern. Across all test instances, the dialogue history contains no outstanding user requests or monitoring instructions. Each video has one human-annotated trigger window marking when a visual cue offers an opportunity to build on this context, and the trigger rate is computed over these 25 windows. All messages within a window are jointly scored from 0 to 5 on how specifically and usefully they address the user’s previously expressed need, interest, or concern. Quality is averaged over triggered windows; messages outside annotated windows are excluded.
blocks.zh: 视觉-对话背景. 该模型收到一个简短的前置对话,表达用户需要,兴趣或关注. 在所有测试中,对话历史中没有未完成的用户请求或监测指令。 每段视频都有一个人为附加说明的触发窗口标记,当一个视觉提示提供了在这个上下文的基础上发展的机会时,触发率就计算在这25个窗口上。 窗口内的所有信息都从0到5共同得分,说明它们如何具体和有益地满足用户先前表达的需求、兴趣或关切。 质量平均在被触发的窗口上;附加说明的窗口外的信息不包括在内.

blocks.en: Visual-Only Context. This setting provides no dialogue history, and evaluation covers the entire video. The judge additionally receives a scene summary and human-verified visual details. Each message is rated Good (5), Neutral (2.5), or Bad (0). Good messages are accurate and provide specific information, actionable help, or meaningful interaction grounded in the scene; Neutral messages offer limited value or contain minor flaws; Bad messages contain a core factual error, valueless repetition, or harmful content. Quality is averaged across messages within each video, then equally across videos; a silent video receives a score of 0.

blocks.en: Table 6 summarizes the MIC performance of AURA 2.0. With dialogue context, the model triggers in 80.0% of annotated windows (20/25) and achieves a mean quality of 4.10/5, indicating well-targeted contributions, although some relevant opportunities remain unaddressed. Without an expressed user need or interest to guide topic selection, the model may find it harder to distinguish observations worth sharing from those of limited value. blocks.en: 7.4 Evaluation of Stream-Aware Tool Calling
blocks.zh: 7.4 评价流动智能工具调用

blocks.en: We evaluate SATC on an internal benchmark containing 167 questions across 55 video clips, covering transportation, landmarks, plants, and other everyday subjects. We compare AURA 2.0 with tools enabled and disabled, using an LLM judge to assess final answers against reference answers. Enabling tools improves accuracy from 35.9% to 48.5%, a gain of 12.6 percentage points. The model invokes tools for 41.3% of questions, making 73 calls in total. These results demonstrate the value of external information for answering questions grounded in the video stream.
blocks.zh: 包括交通、地标、植物和其他日常主题。 我们把AURA 2.0与启用和被禁用的工具进行比较,使用LLM法官对照参考答案评估最终答案. 辅助工具的精度从35.9%提高到48.5%,提高了12.6%。 该模型为41.3%的问题引用了工具,总共打了73通电话. 这些结果表明,外部信息对回答基于视频流的问题很有价值。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , AURA 2.0 achieves an mIoU of 0.906 and an accuracy of 94.0%, versus 0.635 and 76.0% for Qwen3.5-9B. It returns boxes for all 37 positive queries, versus the backbone’s 26. On the 26 queries where both models return boxes, mean IoUs are similar (0.906 vs. 0.903, respectively), indicating that the overall improvement comes primarily from fewer missing outputs. For absent targets, AURA 2.0 correctly abstains on 11 of 13 queries, versus all 13 for the backbone.

blocks.en: Figure 8 illustrates this improvement on less salient and partially visible targets. AURA 2.0 localizes the handbag and bus missed by the backbone, while both models identify the remote control beside the cat. blocks.zh: 图8显示这种改进是针对不太突出和部分可见的目标。 AURA 2.0将主干错过的手提包和公交车本地化,而两个型号都识别出猫旁边的遥控器. 这些例子支持定量结论,即更加一致的边框输出可以提高所请求的目标的覆盖范围.

blocks.en: 7.6 Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 7.6 推论效率

blocks.en: All measurements are run on a server with two accelerators of about 140 GB memory each. The language model occupies one accelerator; speech recognition, speech synthesis, and codec decoding share the other. We stream videos from OmniInteract ( Lu et al., 2026c ) in real time and inject each spoken query as audio at its annotated time. With multiple concurrent sessions, each session starts at a random offset within the first 10 s. Each concurrency level is run three times; we pool the runs and report medians over turns in which the model responds with speech.
blocks.zh: 所有测量都运行在一个服务器上,两个加速器各有大约140GB内存. 语言模型占据一个加速器;语音识别,语音合成,和编码解码共享另一个. 我们实时流出OmniInteract(Lu et al., 2026c.)的视频,并在附加说明的时间将每个口语查询作为音频输入. 在同时举行多场会话的情况下,每场会话在前10会话内以随机冲抵方式开始. 每个货币水平运行三次;我们汇集运行并报告中位数,模型用语音响应。

blocks.en:
All times except Time Per Output Token (TPOT) are measured at the client, starting from the moment the client submits a turn (the end of the spoken query).
Time to First Token (TTFT) is the time until the first response text arrives, including speech recognition.
Time To First Packet (TTFP) is the time until the first reply audio packet arrives.
Real-Time Factor (RTF) is the time until the last audio packet arrives, divided by the duration of the received reply audio; values below 1 indicate that speech is delivered faster than it is played.
TPOT covers only the language-model stage and is reported by the serving engine.
blocks.zh:
除"时间"(Time Per Outser Token (TPOT))之外,所有时间都由客户端测量,从客户端提交转盘(口语查询结束)起算.
Time to First Token(TTFT)是第一个响应文本到达的时间,包括语音识别.
Time To First Packet(TTFP)是第一个回复音频包到达的时间.
实时因子(RTF)是最后一个音频包到达之前的时间,除以收到的回复音频的持续时间;低于1的值表示语音的发送快于播放.
TPOT只覆盖语言-模型阶段,由服务引擎报告.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 结论和限制

blocks.en: We present AURA 2.0, a streaming VideoLLM that extends query-driven interaction with model-initiated conversation. Its core capability, MIC, enables the model to identify topics worth discussing and initiate conversations based on evolving visual observations and prior dialogue. SATC and IVG further support external tool use and visually grounded interaction. A dedicated streaming interaction dataset and three-stage training scheme integrate these capabilities with existing streaming QA behaviors. LHIM preserves historical events as compact textual memories, while serving optimizations reduce response latency. Evaluations on four public streaming benchmarks demonstrate strong performance in video understanding and response timing. Targeted evaluations show useful MIC openings, improved answer accuracy with tool access, and fewer missing bounding-box outputs for requested targets. Together, these results demonstrate progress toward streaming assistants that both respond to user requests and identify opportunities to initiate conversations.
blocks.zh: 我们呈现AURA 2.0,一个流动的视频LLM,扩展了由查询驱动的与模型启动的对话的互动. 其核心能力,即军事工业中心,使该模式能够确定值得讨论的议题,并根据不断发展的视觉观察和先前的对话发起对话。 SATC和IVG进一步支持外部工具的使用和可视化的互动. 一个专门的流动交互数据集和三相培训计划将这些能力与现有的流动QA行为相融合. LHIM将历史事件保存为紧凑的文字记忆,而服务优化则会降低响应的延迟. 对四项公共流程基准的评价显示,在视频理解和反应时间安排方面表现良好。 目标明确的评价显示有实用的MIC开口,使用工具的答案准确性得到提高,对所要求目标而言,缺少的限定框产出较少。 这些结果共同显示,在流程助理两方面都取得了进展,这些助理既响应用户的要求,又确定启动对话的机会。

blocks.en: The usefulness of MIC is inherently subjective and depends on individual preferences for topic, timing, and speaking frequency. Future work should incorporate user preferences and broader interaction context to better determine when and how to engage. Our current system uses a cascaded ASR–VideoLLM–TTS pipeline, which we plan to extend to an omni-modal, full-duplex model. For example, during piano practice, such a model could listen to the user’s performance and observe their hand movements while providing spoken guidance. It could adjust its ongoing feedback upon hearing a wrong note and identifying the corresponding fingering error. This simultaneous listening, viewing, and speaking is not supported by our current system.
blocks.zh: MIC的有用性在本质上是主观的,取决于个人对专题、时间和发言频率的偏好。 今后的工作应包括用户的偏好和更广泛的互动背景,以更好地确定何时以及如何参与。 我们目前的系统使用一个级联的ASR-VideoLLM-TTS输油管,我们计划将输油管扩展到一个全方位、全双倍的型号。 例如,在钢琴练习期间,这种模型可以听取用户的表演并观察他们的手动,同时提供口语指导. 它在听到错误的注释并找出相应的指法错误后,可以调整其持续反馈. 我们目前的系统不支持这种同时倾听、观看和发言的做法。
